findings.title: The yield instrument's verdict population is not the review rounds the verdict bus records: 42 rounds missing, 9 counted twice
findings.claim: Over the 234 merges of v7.1.10..92d38ecb, policy_lint.mjs --stats (fetchWindow + statsHistogram, comments and reviews) reads 420 verdict comments, while the verdict bus holds 452 distinct (PR, word, head) verdicts: 42 bus verdicts (24 blocked, over 32 PRs, every head an ancestor of the merged branch) never reached the PR as a comment or review, and 9 comments are second relays of one verdict (same bus-nonce), so rounds per merge reads 2.039 where the bus population read once gives 2.178, one-round yield 0.476 where it gives 0.452, and #3618 (a fix lane with a bus merge verdict) reads as a merge carrying no verdict.
findings.mechanism: A reviewer's verdict is written to the bus (review/<pr>, verdict/<pr>, archived as archive/review/<pr>) and relayed to the PR as an hpo-approver comment; the relay delivered some verdicts never (42, including a cluster written to the bus 2026-11-14 10:45-11:45) and some twice (9, identical bus-nonce, hours apart). fetchWindow reads only /issues/<n>/comments and /pulls/<n>/reviews, and statsHistogram counts every parsable comment as one round; review_strength.py reads the bus. The two in-tree verdict readers therefore count different populations of the same rounds, and the brief's rule (comment or review) inherits the comment side's gaps.

evidence.value: bus_only_verdicts=42 (24 blocked, 32 PRs, 42/42 heads on the merged branch); relay_duplicates=9 (8 PRs); rounds_mean 2.039 -> 2.178; one_round_yield 0.476 -> 0.452; verdict_prs 206 -> 208
evidence.contention_note: count-only; other D13/D15 seats running on the box; numbers do not depend on load. GitHub state read 2026-11-16 (comments can be added or deleted later; the window cache file is printed by the harness)

findings.instrumented_symbol: tools/policy/policy_lint.mjs:statsHistogram (driven over the window as fetchWindow's comment+review stream), with policy_lint.mjs:enumerateMerges/resolvePrFromCommit enumerating the window

perturbation.change: --perturb dedup,bus-union: read each relayed verdict once (drop a comment repeating an earlier bus-nonce) and feed statsHistogram the 42 bus-only verdicts as comments at their bus author time
perturbation.observed_value: comment_verdicts 420 -> 453, rounds_mean 2.039 -> 2.178, verdict_prs 206 -> 208, instrument_repeat_rounds 9 -> 0 (dedup alone: 420 -> 411, rounds_mean 1.995); one_round_yield 0.476 -> 0.452

findings.metric_definition: Distinct (PR, verdict word, 40-hex head) verdicts on the bus for window merges that no comment/review verdict on the PR names, plus comments repeating an earlier comment's bus-nonce on the same PR.
findings.phenomenon_property: Every review round the verdict bus records for a merged PR appears exactly once in the population the first-pass-yield and rounds-per-merge instrument reads (policy_lint.mjs --stats), so its yield, rounds and coverage lines agree with review_strength.py's bus reading of the same window.

null_control.value: 202 of 234 merges carry no bus-only verdict and keep their count under bus-union; first_verdict_yield moves only 0.583 -> 0.587 (ordering-dependent: the 2026-11-14 bus cluster's author time sorts it after the PR's comment verdicts), so the robust effect is on rounds and one-round yield, not on first-verdict yield
null_control.note: The claim is a count, not a cost or a time; the null is the set of PRs the bus and the comments agree on.

reproduction_steps: From the export root, with GITHUB_TOKEN (or the session proxy) for api.github.com and `git ls-remote origin` access:
PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub node dev/audit/rounds/round11/D13/s1/yield_rounds.mjs  (first run fetches the window into os.tmpdir(), ~7 min)
Read RESULT bus_only_verdicts, relay_duplicates, rounds_mean; then --perturb dedup,bus-union and compare.
findings.proposed_fix_scope: Either make the relay post each bus verdict exactly once (idempotent on bus-nonce, and a sweep for bus verdicts with no PR comment), or have policy_lint.mjs --stats read the bus (review_strength.py's population) deduplicated by (PR, word, head); name in the --stats header which population it reads.
